notes.title: Sylvester is born. Are you able to save Gaïa ?
notes.content:
[b]Dive into a visually striking world crafted with Unreal Engine 5, where low-poly models meet cartoon aesthetics in an innovative 3D isometric design.[/b]

[list]
[*] As Sylvester, face your destiny across:
[*] 40+ intense levels spanning 3 diverse biomes,
[*] 25 unique enemy types to outsmart and overpower,
[*] 6 intimidating bosses,
[*] 28 powerful weapons to master and boosters,
[*] Rogue-lite elements : Random weapon drops and boosters keep every run fresh, Permanent death raises the stakes

[b]Are you ready to conquer the Entity of Dust in this unforgiving action-RPG experience ?[/b]
